visual_events.label: Slow push-in on ornate unplastered brick facade and arched lattice gable
visual_events.description: Low-angle exterior shot slowly pushing in (or zooming in) on the upper facade of a completed brick building framed by green tree foliage on the left and right. The building features a barrel-vaulted roof section with a semicircular brick arch framing a recessed decorative screen of angled red bricks forming triangular openings, centered over a smaller solid brick semicircle and a flat red projecting window hood (chajja) supported by corbelled brick brackets above a brown-framed window. Below the arch, the unplastered wall displays alternating wide stretcher-like and narrow header-like brick faces with neatly recessed mortar joints (pointing), painted or finished in a uniform light terracotta tone with deeper red trim bands. A higher rear arch with radial circular perforations is visible at the top of the frame from 0.0s until it moves out of the upper frame edge around 3.0s as the framing tightens on the central arch and window hood.

visual_events.uncertainty: Whether the camera movement is an optical zoom or physical dolly/push-in is uncertain; internal wall cavity structure is not visible from the finished exterior.
